title: Alarm-driven enforcement service that survives reboot and Doze
objective: Give the enforcement decision a runtime: something that applies it at the moments it can change, survives a reboot, and is not silently deferred by Doze. Success is a service that runs, arms its own next run, fires exactly at scheduled times, and refuses to act when not provisioned rather than failing quietly.
acceptance_criteria: The service applies one pass then stops; it is not resident and does not poll
Curfew boundaries fire exactly - window=0 in dumpsys alarm, not a multi-minute window
A reboot re-arms the schedule even before the user unlocks
The service reports and does nothing when neither device owner nor profile owner, rather than failing silently
A failure inside a pass cannot stop the next run being scheduled
packagesToShow is applied unconditionally each pass so a missed run self-repairs
out_of_scope: Device Owner provisioning - the service correctly no-ops without it
The actual hide/show application: the decision layer and the DPM call both exist, wiring them together is next
Location and workout providers - interfaces exist, platform plumbing does not
verifier: adb install + am start; adb logcat for the boot and service lines; dumpsys alarm to confirm window=0 and exactAllowReason; flutter analyze && flutter test
